lines.en: label makihornytrip1:
scene sky
I tap on Haruka’s name in my phone and prepare myself for yet another free vacation.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Haruka 的名字，为又一次免费度假做好准备。

lines.en: Just, this time, it’s for the very specific purpose of reminding one of our friends that she is supposed to be horny all the time — which she currently is not.
lines.zh: 只不过这一次，目的非常明确：提醒我们的一位朋友，她本该是全天候发情的——而她目前并不是。

lines.en: Is this as big of a problem as Haruka seems to think it is? Probably not. But, then again, this {i}is{/i} Maki we’re talking about. And I’m not sure she’s had any time off ever since the whole husband thing happened.
lines.zh: 这事真有 Haruka 以为的那么严重吗？大概没有。不过话说回来，这{i}可是{/i} Maki。而且我不确定她自从丈夫那件事之后有没有休息过。

lines.en: Plus, things have been pretty crazy for me lately as well. So maybe I could use a bit of rest and relaxation too?
lines.zh: 再说，我最近的日子也够乱的。所以也许我也该休息放松一下？

lines.en: I say that fully aware that this will somehow wind up either depressing, extremely sexual, or just not relaxing at all.
lines.zh: 我说这话的时候完全清楚，最后不管怎样，不是变成压抑，就是变得极度色情，或者干脆一点都不放松。

lines.en: But hey, it’s worth a shot.
lines.zh: 不过嘿，值得一试。

lines.en: : Mm...what do you want? It’s 7:00 AM...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你想干嘛？现在才早上七点……

lines.en: : So what? Aren’t you usually going to work around this time?
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？你平时不也差不多这会儿去上班吗？

lines.en: : Aren’t you usually {i}sleeping{/i} around this time?...
lines.zh: : 你平时不也差不多这会儿在{i}睡觉{/i}吗？……

lines.en: : Not when I know there’s a free trip still hanging in limbo.
lines.zh: : 如果我知道还有一趟免费旅行悬在半空，我就不会睡了。

lines.en: : What?...
: Get dressed, Haruka. It’s vacation time.
lines.zh: : 穿好衣服，Haruka。度假时间到了。

lines.en: : Mngh...five more minutes...
lines.zh: : 嗯呃……再睡五分钟……

lines.en: : Fine. I’ll call Maki in the meantime and let her know what’s going on.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我先给 Maki 打个电话，让她知道情况。

lines.en: : Wait-
lines.zh: : 等等-

lines.en: I hang up the phone and dial Maki’s number. I hope she’s prepared to regain her libido.
lines.zh: 我挂断电话，拨通 Maki 的号码。希望她已经准备好把自己的性欲找回来。

lines.en: : Hey.
: Hey.
: Is it boner time?
lines.zh: : 是勃起时间吗？

lines.en: : It’s boner time.
lines.zh: : 是勃起时间。

lines.en: : I’ll pack my bag.
lines.zh: : 我去收拾包。

lines.en: scene black
Well, that was easier than I expected it to be.
lines.zh: 嗯，这比我预想的容易多了。

lines.en: I guess all that’s left now is to wait for Haruka to get ready and...figure out where the three of us are going to meet up.
lines.zh: 我想现在就只剩等 Haruka 收拾好，还有……弄清楚我们三个要在哪儿碰头了。

lines.en: Both of them drive so I’m sure that one of them will wind up swinging by to pick me up, but-
lines.zh: 她们俩都会开车，所以我敢肯定其中一个会顺路来接我，不过-

lines.en: Never mind.
lines.zh: 算了。

lines.en: It’ll be fine.
lines.zh: 不会有事的。

lines.en: I need to focus on relaxing.
lines.zh: 我得把注意力放在放松上。

lines.en: scene harukamakicar1
As predicted, Haruka shows up a couple hours later with Maki already in tow and the three of us set course to...wherever it is we’re going. I’m still not really sure.
lines.zh: 不出所料，几个小时后 Haruka 出现了，Maki 已经跟在她车上，我们三个便动身前往……我们要去的那个地方。我还是不太确定是哪儿。

lines.en: I decided against packing anything since I can always just sleep naked and...also wanted to avoid Ami noticing some of my things are missing as I’m sure she takes inventory of my possessions nightly.
lines.zh: 我决定什么行李都不带，反正我光着身子也能睡，而且……也想避免 Ami 发现我的东西少了——我敢肯定她每晚都要清点我的私人物品。

lines.en: Haruka drives slower than Maki — almost like she’s been made aware of how {i}fidgety{/i} I can be in places like this.
lines.zh: Haruka 开车比 Maki 慢——简直像是有人提醒过她，我在这种地方会多么{i}坐立不安{/i}。

lines.en: And I’m sure the one who informed her is the same one listening to podcasts with her feet up in the back of the car right now.
lines.zh: 而我可以肯定，告诉她的那个人，正是此刻在车后座翘着脚听播客的那位。

lines.en: Either way, this will be over before I know it and we’ll all have a great time turning each other on or whatever it is we’re supposed to be doing today.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，这一切在我反应过来之前就会结束，而我们都会度过一段美好时光，互相把对方点燃，或者随便今天本来该干什么。

lines.en: I haven’t forgotten, it’s just a little harder to fully remember when I’m so focused on the clouds shadowing us from behind the trees.
lines.zh: 我没忘，只是当我一门心思盯着那些从树后飘出来、为我们遮阴的云时，要完全想起来就有点难了。

lines.en: : You good?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : 为什么这么问？

lines.en: : You’ve been tapping your foot ever since I picked you up. And I’m pretty sure it’s not to the soothing sounds of the Joe Rogan Show leaking out of Maki’s AirPods.
lines.zh: : 从我接上你开始，你的脚就一直在打拍子。而且我敢肯定，那不是跟着 Maki 的 AirPods 里漏出来的《乔·罗根秀》的舒缓声音。

lines.en: I am apparently a bit less discreet about my discomfort than I thought.
lines.zh: 看来我对自己不适的掩饰，比我想的要差一点。

lines.en: : I’m good. You don’t have to worry about me.
lines.zh: : 我没事。你不用替我担心。

lines.en: : Of course I have to worry about you.
lines.zh: : 我当然得替你担心。

lines.en: scene harukamakicar2
: Even {i}if{/i} the main purpose of this trip is to fix Maki, it doesn’t mean that’s what it’s {i}all{/i} about.
lines.zh: : {i}就算{/i}这趟旅行的主要目的是治好 Maki，也不代表它就{i}只{/i}有这个意义。

lines.en: : You’re my friend. And if there’s one thing I’ve learned about myself lately, it’s that I don’t always put you guys first when I probably should.
lines.zh: : 你是我的朋友。而且如果说我最近对自己有什么认识，那就是：我该把你们放在第一位的时候，却常常没有做到。

lines.en: : Can you save your character development until we’re out of the car, please?
lines.zh: : 你能不能等我们下车了再做人物成长，拜托？

lines.en: scene harukamakicar3
: Hm? Did somebody say something? Because if somebody said something, I didn’t hear it. I’m listening to the Joe Rogan Show on my AirPods.
lines.zh: : 嗯？有人说话吗？因为如果有人说话了，我可没听见。我正在用我的 AirPods 听《乔·罗根秀》。

lines.en: : Yes, Maki. We know. Go back to listening to the Joe Rogan Show on your AirPods.
lines.zh: : 是的，Maki。我们知道。继续用你的 AirPods 听《乔·罗根秀》吧。

lines.en: : Okay. I’m going to go back to listening to the Joe Rogan Show on my AirPods now.
lines.zh: : 好的。我现在要继续用我的 AirPods 听《乔·罗根秀》了。

lines.en: scene harukamakicar4
: I feel like there’s some kind of joke here I’m not getting.
lines.zh: : 我感觉这里有个我没听懂的梗。

lines.en: : And I feel like now is the perfect time for character development since Maki is listening to the Joe Rogan Show on her AirPods.
lines.zh: : 而我觉得现在是做人物成长的最佳时机，因为 Maki 正用她的 AirPods 听着《乔·罗根秀》。

lines.en: scene harukamakicar5
: Listen, we’ve known each other for a while now, haven’t we?
lines.zh: : 听着，我们认识也有段时间了，对吧？

lines.en: : I mean...I guess. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 我是说……大概吧。嗯。

lines.en: : And within that time I have made out with you behind my husband’s back, hid it from Sara, turned everyone’s problems into my own, and then abandoned Maki when she needed me most.
lines.zh: : 而在这段时间里，我背着我丈夫跟你亲热过，瞒着 Sara，把所有人的问题都变成我自己的，还在 Maki 最需要我的时候抛下了她。

lines.en: : I’ve been kind of a bitch. We don’t have to pretend I haven’t been. I get that now. But that’s exactly why I’m trying to kind of, like...turn things around. And think of other people for once.
lines.zh: : 我一直有点婊。我们不用假装我不是。我现在明白了。可这正是我为什么想试着……扭转过来。也该为别人想想了。

lines.en: : I’ve never been great at that, but it’s not because I don’t care about you guys or anything. I’ve just always...put myself first, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我从来都不擅长这个，但那不是因为我不在乎你们什么的。我只是……一直把自己放在第一位吧，大概。

lines.en: : I don’t think there’s any harm in that, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那也没什么不好，Haruka。

lines.en: scene harukamakicar6

: Yeah, well you’re not the one trying to turn things around. I am. So don’t say stuff like, “You don’t have to worry about me,” because it like, totally goes against everything I’ve been telling myself lately.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可那个想扭转过来的人不是你，是我。所以别说什么「你不用替我担心」，因为那简直……跟我最近告诉自己的一切完全相反。

lines.en: scene harukamakicar7
: This trip’s for you guys, not me. Well, it’s mostly for Maki. And it was originally for Maki {i}and{/i} Sara. But you’re a suitable replacement.
lines.zh: : 这趟旅行是为你们，不是为我。嗯，主要是为了 Maki。原本是给 Maki {i}和{/i} Sara 的。不过你是个合适的替代品。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if you’ll attract as many people as she would, though. Even {i}with{/i} the penis. Sara’s kind of popular with the younger crowds and gets stared at {i}a lot.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不过我不确定你能不能像她那样吸引那么多人。就算{i}有{/i}那根鸡巴也不一定。Sara 在年轻人里挺受欢迎，而且{i}经常{/i}被盯着看。

lines.en: : Probably because she blends in with them.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为她混在她们中间毫无违和感。

lines.en: : Probably. I’m too busy also staring to really figure that out, but that doesn’t matter now. What matters is having a relaxing day and then leaving this place tomorrow feeling refreshed and reinvigorated.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。我自己也在忙着盯着看，实在没空去弄明白，不过那现在不重要。重要的是今天过得放松，然后明天离开这里时觉得神清气爽、重新充满活力。

lines.en: : And in Maki’s case, horny. Hopefully.
lines.zh: : 而 Maki 那边，得发情。希望如此。

lines.en: : You really think just getting a day off at some fancy resort is going to be enough to set her back on track?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得在某个高级度假村放一天假，就足以让她回到正轨？

lines.en: : No.
: But I think it’s a start.
lines.zh: : 但我觉得这是个开始。

lines.en: scene black
: And a “start” never hurt anybody.
lines.zh: : 而一个「开始」从来不会伤到任何人。

lines.en: Somewhere along the way, the tapping of my left foot stops.
lines.zh: 不知从什么时候起，我左脚打拍子的动作停了。

lines.en: I do not alternate to my right- and I do not compensate by tapping my other limbs instead.
lines.zh: 我没有换右脚继续——也没有靠敲别的肢体来补偿。

lines.en: I simply focus on the clouds and the trees that try to hide them.
lines.zh: 我只是专注于那些云，和试图把它们藏起来的树。

lines.en: Soon enough, they’ll run out of cover.
lines.zh: 很快，它们就会无遮可躲。

lines.en: And soon enough, so will I.
lines.zh: 而很快，我也会。

lines.en: scene harukamakicar8
Haruka and Maki waste no time at all when it comes to changing into their swimsuits and I wind up meeting up with them after renting one that looks eerily similar to the one I have at home.
lines.zh: Haruka 和 Maki 换泳衣一点没耽搁，而我在租了一套跟家里那套出奇相似的泳衣之后，才跟她们汇合。

lines.en: Also, I’m sure it goes without saying, but if the objective of this trip was to get {i}me{/i} horny, we could probably just pack up and head home now because {i}wow.{/i}
lines.zh: 还有，这我大概不用多说，不过如果这趟旅行的目的是让{i}我{/i}发情，那我们现在就可以收拾收拾回家了，因为……{i}哇{/i}。

lines.en: Though, I guess it’s possible I just spend so much time around girls who have barely outgrown training bras that seeing two fully developed women at once just {i}gets{/i} to me, you know?
lines.zh: 不过，我想也可能是因为我平时身边全是些刚脱下训练胸罩的丫头，所以一下看到两个发育完全的女人就{i}顶不住{/i}了，你懂的？

lines.en: But I digress as this is the part of the day where I squeeze my way into a conversation that would best be left between two girls.
lines.zh: 不过我扯远了，因为现在到了这个时候，我要硬挤进一段本该只属于两个女孩的对话。

lines.en: Or rather, two best friends — as I might be a replacement for Sara, but I will never be a {i}replacement{/i} for Sara.
lines.zh: 更准确地说，是两个最好的朋友——因为我可以当 Sara 的{i}替代品{/i}，但我永远也成不了 Sara 的替代品。

lines.en: : Is there anything in particular you want to do today? I got massages lined up for the two of us a few hours from now. And we’ve got dinner reservations at 5:00. But if there’s anything else, just tell me.
lines.zh: : 你今天有什么特别想做的吗？几小时后我给咱们俩安排了按摩。五点还订了晚餐。不过如果你还有别的想法，直接跟我说就行。

lines.en: : You’re really going all out, huh? You’ve never splurged on me like this before. And I’d know because I’ve been splurged on by at least like, twenty guys. Probably more.
lines.zh: : 你真是拼了啊？你以前可从没为我在我身上这么挥霍过。我敢肯定，因为至少有大概二十个男人在我身上挥霍过。说不定更多。

lines.en: : That second splurge was supposed to be “splooge.”
lines.zh: : 第二个“挥霍”本来该说成“喷射”的。

lines.en: : Like, cum. I’m saying at least twenty guys have came on me. And you are currently...financially cumming on me. Or something.
lines.zh: : 就是，精液。我的意思是至少有二十个男人射在我身上。而你现在……是在金钱上射在我身上。之类的。

lines.en: : You done?
lines.zh: : 你说完了吗？

lines.en: scene harukamakicar9
: Yeah, sorry. My heart’s just not in it right now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，抱歉。我现在就是没那个心情。

lines.en: : That’s fine. There’s no need to rush or anything. We can take it one hour at a time.
lines.zh: : 没关系。不用着急什么的。我们可以一个小时一个小时地来。

lines.en: scene harukamakicar10
: But also know that I won’t hold it against you if you start returning to normal halfway through the trip and want to run off with Sensei for a little fun.
lines.zh: : 不过也先说清楚，要是你在这趟旅行进行到一半时恢复正常了，想跟老师跑去找点乐子，我绝对不会怪你。

lines.en: if makisex == True:
: I’m good, but thanks.
lines.zh: : 我没事，不过谢谢。

lines.en: : Wow, okay.
lines.zh: : 哇，行吧。

lines.en: : Are you suuuuure? Not even the tip? Because the tip doesn’t count.
lines.zh: : 你真的——确定吗？连个头都不行吗？因为龟头不算的。

lines.en: : I don’t think it works that way.
lines.zh: : 我觉得不是这么算的。

lines.en: : I’m an authority on the subject and I can confirm that Haruka is right. The tip doesn’t count. It’s shaft or nothing.
lines.zh: : 我在这件事上算是权威，我可以确认 Haruka 说得对。龟头不算。要么整根进去，要么什么都没有。

lines.en: : Okay then. Maybe it works that way after all and I’m just behind on the times.
lines.zh: : 那好吧。也许本来就是这么算的，只是我落伍了。

lines.en: else:
: Yeah...something tells me neither one of us thinks that’s going to happen.
lines.zh: : 嗯……有种感觉告诉我，我们俩谁都不觉得那会发生。

lines.en: : What happens at fancy resorts stays at fancy resorts. I won’t tell anyone.
lines.zh: : 在高级度假村发生的事，就留在高级度假村。我不会告诉任何人的。

lines.en: : I...don’t think that’s the problem here.
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得问题在这儿。

lines.en: scene harukamakicar11
: Maki, come on! What’s with that expression? Lighten up a little! Go flirt with randoms and...ego-surf or something. There are plenty of people around here who’d be happy to hit on you.
lines.zh: : Maki，拜托！你那是什么表情？放松一点！去跟陌生人调调情，或者……自我搜索一下什么的。这附近大把人很乐意来搭讪你。

lines.en: : Am I supposed to go around and flirt with people or lean back and relax? You’re pushing me in multiple directions and I’m not sure which one will get me closer to you being a little less...Haruka.
lines.zh: : 我到底是该到处跟人调情，还是往后一靠放松？你把我往好几个方向推，我不确定哪一条能让你变得稍微不那么……Haruka。

lines.en: : Maki, all I want is for you to get back to your normal self. It hurts {i}all{/i} of us seeing you so...blah all the time.
lines.zh: : Maki，我只想要你变回原来的自己。看到你一直这么……没劲，我们{i}所有人{/i}都难受。

lines.en: : I’m not even “blah,” though. I’m just...not as interested in sex anymore.
lines.zh: : 可我并不是「没劲」。我只是……对性没那么感兴趣了。

lines.en: scene harukamakicar12
: But {i}why?{/i} Sex is awesome. You love sex. I love sex. Everybody loves sex.
lines.zh: : 可{i}为什么？{/i}性爱超棒的。你爱性爱。我爱性爱。人人都爱性爱。

lines.en: : If sex is so good, how come there’s no sex 2?
lines.zh: : 如果性爱这么好，为什么没有性爱 2？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Yeah, what?
lines.zh: : 是啊，什么？

lines.en: : What I’m saying is...if you love sex so much, why don’t you just marry it?
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……如果你这么爱性爱，为什么不干脆跟它结婚？

lines.en: scene harukamakicar13
: Again, what? Also, I’m already married.
lines.zh: : 又来，什么？而且我已经结婚了。

lines.en: : Wow. Rub it in, why don’t you?
lines.zh: : 哇。你就非要往我伤口上撒盐是吧？

lines.en: : Maki...
lines.zh: : Maki……

lines.en: : Haruka, if you want to leave me behind to go “flirt with randoms” and be all sexual and stuff, more power to you. Go for it. I always thought you’d be better off in an open marriage anyway.
lines.zh: : Haruka，要是你想把我丢下，去「跟陌生人调情」、尽情性感一番，那你尽管去。我本来就一直觉得你更适合开放式婚姻。

lines.en: : That way, you could still hang out with your buddies Sex 1 and Sex 2 and be totally guilt-free about it.
lines.zh: : 那样你就能继续跟你的好哥们「性爱 1 号」和「性爱 2 号」混在一起，而且完全不用有负罪感。

lines.en: scene harukamakicar14
: You know a lot of people just view that as cheating though, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道很多人就把它当出轨看吧，对吧？

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
: A lot of people view cheating as cheating too and that hasn’t stopped you yet.
lines.zh: : 很多人也把出轨当出轨看，可那也没能拦住你啊。

lines.en: : Oof.
lines.zh: : 哎哟。

lines.en: else:
: And a lot of people think pineapple belongs on pizza. That doesn’t mean they’re right. It means they have a stupid fucking opinion and the world would be better without them.
lines.zh: : 还有很多人觉得菠萝该放披萨上。那不代表他们是对的。那代表他们有个愚蠢至极的观点，而这个世界没有他们会更好。

lines.en: : I’m glad that sort of thing works for you, I’m just...I’m not really sure it would work for me personally. Nor do I think I can just convert the relationship to “open” while my husband is fighting aliens.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴那套对你管用，我只是……不太确定它对我个人也管用。而且我也不觉得我能在我丈夫正在跟外星人打仗的时候，把这段关系干脆改成「开放式」。

lines.en: : It'd make more sense to just...end the marriage altogether, I think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……倒不如干脆把这段婚姻整个结束掉，还更说得通。

lines.en: : Haruka, for all we know, he might be {i}fucking{/i} aliens. Which, again, would be totally cool if your marriage was open.
lines.zh: : Haruka，说不定他在{i}操{/i}外星人呢。而再说一次，如果你的婚姻是开放式的，那就完全没问题了。

lines.en: : I bet Masahiro fucked at least one alien before he died. I know {i}I{/i} would’ve. Well, back when I was still horny, at least. Right now, there might be a little...conflict in terms of getting it in.
lines.zh: : 我打赌 Masahiro 死之前至少操过一个外星人。换我{i}我{/i}肯定会。嗯，至少在我还会发情的时候。现在嘛，在「插进去」这件事上可能会有点……冲突。

lines.en: : Unless alien dicks are self-lubricating. Which they might be. We don’t really know. But I hope they are. Or were. For Masahiro’s sake.
lines.zh: : 除非外星人的鸡巴是自带润滑的。说不定就是。我们也不清楚。不过我希望是。或者曾经是。为了 Masahiro 好。

lines.en: scene harukamakicar15
: As good a saleswoman as you are, I’m not sure if open marriages are the sort of thing you should be peddling onto other people when they’re most definitely not for all of us.
lines.zh: : 你推销本事再好，我也不确定开放式婚姻这种东西该不该拿来兜售给别人，毕竟它绝对不是对每个人都合适。

lines.en: : But they {i}should{/i} be because sex and love don’t always have to be linked. Sometimes, you just want to try something different. And don’t pretend for a second you don’t.
lines.zh: : 可它{i}应该{/i}合适，因为性和爱不一定要绑在一起。有时候你就是想试试不一样的。而且你别装作自己没这么想过，一秒都别装。

lines.en: scene harukamakicar16
: I’m not “pretending” anything. It’s perfectly normal to fantasize about stuff. It’s only {i}wrong{/i} once you actually act on it.
lines.zh: : 我什么都没「装」。对某些事有幻想是完全正常的。只有真的付诸行动才是{i}错的{/i}。

lines.en: if harukasex == True:

: Then what’s the problem at this point? You two are already having sex. And cool, friend-sex at that. Wouldn’t it be better if that was just {i}allowed{/i} rather than something you have to feel guilty about?
lines.zh: : 那现在问题在哪儿？你们俩已经在做爱了。而且还是酷毙了的「炮友性爱」。如果那是{i}被允许{/i}的，而不是一件你必须感到内疚的事，不是更好吗？

lines.en: else:
: “Wrong” is subjective. There’s no definitive right or wrong when it comes to stuff like love and sex. It’s not, like...murder or something. It’s way simpler than that.
lines.zh: : 「错」是主观的。在爱情和性这种事上，没有绝对的错与对。它又不是……谋杀什么的。比那简单多了。

lines.en: : I thought the whole open marriage thing was your husband’s idea, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我以为开放式婚姻那套是你丈夫的主意，不是吗？

lines.en: : Just because it was his idea doesn’t mean I can’t like it as well, does it?
lines.zh: : 那是他的主意，不代表我就不能也喜欢它，对吧？

lines.en: : I think it was great for us in a bunch of ways, and that it would be great for a lot of other people as well if they could overlook the stigmas surrounding it.
lines.zh: : 我觉得它在很多方面对我们都很棒，而且如果别人能忽略围绕它的那些污名，对很多人也会很棒。

lines.en: : Either way, it’s too late to just change now. That would have had to be something we talked about beforehand.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，现在想改已经太迟了。那本来该是我们事先谈好的事。

lines.en: : Maybe you already did? Your husband had no problem with {i}me{/i} fucking you. Who’s saying he wouldn’t have budged if somebody else wanted to as well?
lines.zh: : 也许你们早就谈过了？你丈夫对{i}我{/i}操你都没意见。谁说如果别人也想，他就不会让步了？

lines.en: : Can we go back to talking about you now? I’ve somehow become the target of this and I’m not quite sure how or why.
lines.zh: : 我们能回过头聊你了吗？不知怎么的，我成了靶子，而我不太清楚是怎么、为什么。

lines.en: : The {i}why{/i} is because you’ve been pushing my buttons nonstop lately and I wanted to push yours for a minute or two as revenge. The {i}how{/i} is kind of self-explanatory.
lines.zh: : {i}为什么{/i}，是因为你最近一直在不停踩我的按钮，我想作为报复也踩你一两分钟。至于{i}怎么{/i}变成这样的，那就有点不言自明了。

lines.en: scene harukamakicar17
: You really think I’ve been pushing your buttons?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我最近一直在踩你的按钮？

lines.en: : Yes. But I know you’re doing it out of love this time, so that makes it kind of okay.
lines.zh: : 是。不过我知道这次你是出于爱才这么做的，所以那也就还好。

lines.en: : Honestly, I know this whole no-horny thing is probably shocking to both of you. But I don’t think a one day vacation or flirting with young people is going to fix that.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我知道这个「不发情」的事大概让你们俩都很震惊。但我不觉得一天的假期、或者跟年轻人调调情就能修好它。

lines.en: scene harukamakicar18
: What about a fancy dinner? Or wine? Or a fancy dinner {i}with{/i} wine? Or a sensual massage from an androgynous therapist with extremely strong hands?
lines.zh: : 那高级晚餐呢？或者葡萄酒？或者{i}有酒{/i}的高级晚餐？或者由一位中性气质、手劲极大的技师来做一场感官按摩？

lines.en: : That last one does sound nice. But that might just be because I’m old and my back hurts all the time.
lines.zh: : 最后那个听起来确实不错。不过那也许只是因为我老了，背一直疼。

lines.en: scene harukamakicar19
: {i}Your{/i} back hurts? Give me a break. Like a third of my body weight is latched onto my chest and trying to pull me down all day.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}背疼？得了吧。我体重的三分之一都挂在我胸口上，整天想把我往地上拽。

lines.en: : Yes, but I have probably spent significantly more time in strange sex positions than you have. And those can take a toll on a woman.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可我在各种奇怪性爱姿势上花的时间大概比你多得多。那些对女人是有损耗的。

lines.en: scene harukamakicar20
: Fair.
lines.zh: : 有道理。

lines.en: : You can have it your way once we leave the resort. I’ll stop pestering you about stress levels and the reclamation of your libido and just...let you do your own thing.
lines.zh: : 等我们离开度假村，你想怎么样都行。我不会再拿压力水平和找回性欲的事烦你，就……让你自己来。

lines.en: : But for the rest of today, I’d be happy if you humored me by coming along for all of the stuff I planned. Or, at the very least, just trying to relax in some form.
lines.zh: : 不过今天剩下的时间，如果你能赏脸陪我走完我安排的那些，或者至少……试着以某种方式放松一下，我就很高兴了。

lines.en: : I’ve been trying to do that since we sat down and you made it weird by telling me to go fuck our other friend.
lines.zh: : 从我们坐下开始我一直在试着放松，结果你叫我去操我们另一个朋友，把气氛弄得很怪。

lines.en: : I didn’t tell you to fuck him. I said I’d be {i}okay{/i} with you fucking him. Which I am.
lines.zh: : 我没叫你去操他。我是说你操他我也{i}能接{/i}受。而我{i}确实{/i}接受。

lines.en: : Thank you for the clarification. Boner time is over. Nap time is now.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的澄清。勃起时间结束了。现在是午睡时间。

lines.en: : Hi. “Other friend” here. What am I supposed to do while the two of you sit there with your eyes closed?
lines.zh: : 嗨。「另一个朋友」在这儿。你们俩闭着眼睛坐在那儿，我该干嘛？

lines.en: : Go flirt with randoms since Maki won’t and I made the apparent mistake of not opening my marriage.
lines.zh: : 既然 Maki 不去，那你去跟陌生人调情吧，而我显然犯了个错，没把我的婚姻变成开放式的。

lines.en: : Right. And if I can’t find anyone else to have sex with while you’re taking a nap?
lines.zh: : 行。那要是你午睡的时候我找不到别人做爱呢？

lines.en: : Then you can go schedule a massage like I did for Maki and me and hope that your masseuse offers {i}those{/i} kinds of services.
lines.zh: : 那你可以像我给 Maki 和我安排的那样，去约个按摩，然后指望你的按摩师提供{i}那种{/i}服务。

lines.en: : But please be advised that one of us was already kicked out for asking that once.
lines.zh: : 不过提醒你一句，我们其中一个曾经因为问这个被赶出去过。

lines.en: : We will never tell you which one it was.
lines.zh: : 我们永远不会告诉你是哪一个。

lines.en: scene black
: I’m...not sure I even want to know.
lines.zh: : 我……都不确定自己想不想知道。
